fact: A World Bank mission of 8-12 September 2025 saw live demonstrations of functional prototypes of the interoperability and data-exchange platform (DEX), with the interoperability layer to be integrated with the verifiable credentials infrastructure in March 2026.
title: Missão de Apoio a Implementação para o Projecto Digital São Tomé e Príncipe (P177158) - Ajuda Memória
